_how: Each node is one stretch of talk. 'say' is a list of text boxes. Then either 'choices' (a menu), 'next' (another node), or nothing (the talk ends). Markup: [red]..[/] [yellow] [blue] [gray] [gold] [shake] [wave], ^1-^9 pauses, \n new line. A line can be {"text": "..", "face": "smile", "speed": 60} to swap to art/marquez-smile.png or type slower. A choice can have "needs": "nodeId" (only shows once that node was heard; "!nodeId" means NOT heard yet) and "once": true (hides after it's been picked).  A line wrapped in (parentheses) is narration: no nameplate, in italics. Faces: smile, angry, point. Each face talks on its own using its -talk1/-talk2 art. 'name' is the nameplate; a line or node can set its own \"name\". 'returning' is where he starts for someone who has talked to him before.
name: MARQUEZ

say: (A gentleman sits behind a desk in the dark.)
Not many find their way down here. Fewer still think to knock.

say.text: Sit, if you like. I don't get up for anyone anymore.

say: I wondered if you would be.
What would you like to know?
I keep track of things. Stories, mostly.^2 Where they start, and where they've been stitched together wrong.
